profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, traded on public markets under the ticker META. Its website, llama.com, is oriented toward AI developers and describes the company as offering AI models and tools for building applications. The site promotes the Meta Model API, which is described as compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients, and highlights capabilities including search grounding for live web access and image generation through Muse Image, priced at $0.01 per image. The site also references Muse Spark, accessible through Muse Code, and describes a coding-focused model tuned for long-horizon coding workflows that the company says performs competitively with frontier models across several coding evaluations.

Meta's primary tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted. The company reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, per its 10-K filing, and holds SEC CIK number 0001326801. Several third-party MCP servers have been built around Meta's advertising infrastructure, including tools for campaign management, creative testing, and spend optimization across Facebook and Instagram.

Meta faces legal exposure across at least three tracked cases. Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. is pending in the Western District of Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. is in the Northern District of California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., also in the Northern District of California, is among the more widely noted cases involving AI training data. The held facts note 187 points of legal exposure coded to California.
